notablePrerequisites:
Bog Glider and Hua Tuo do not have summoning sickness.
It is your precombat main phase.
description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Universal Automaton.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Universal Automaton on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Universal Automaton and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Universal Automaton enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
